summary: Parents argue that mandatory screen‑time requirements in Sarasota County schools are excessive and negatively affect their children’s well‑being, and they seek the ability to opt their children out of such requirements.

claims.requested_action: allow parent opt‑out of mandatory screen‑time requirements
claims.argument: Parents contend that compulsory screen‑time harms children’s regulation and limits family time, so they oppose it.
